{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning worked
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check if any revenue is still 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99):", (sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
